# Requirement
```text
 Overall/Domain description.
 Console pipe-connection game: grid with outer walls, one source inside pointing inward, one sink on the border
  pointing outward. Player places pipes from a queue; after a delay, water flows along placed pipes.
Cell[][] uses 0-based array indices, but index 0 and rows-1/cols-1 are occupied by the outer wall border. Therefore, the playable area starts at internal index 1: [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2]. Player-facing coordinates are deliberately aligned with these playable indices: row 1 maps to internal row 1, column 'A' maps to internal col 1. No row-1/col-1 conversion is performed.
 Direction provides four directions plus opposite/offset; PipeShape defines
  connection
  directions; TerminationType distinguishes SOURCE vs SINK.

  Functional Requirements

Coordinate and Direction: Coordinate.row and Coordinate.col represent internal Cell[][] array indices and are used directly as cells[row][col]. A Cell stored at cells[r][c] should have Coordinate(row=r, col=c). 
Because the outer wall border occupies index 0, playable cells naturally start at index 1, so player input aligns with internal playable indices.
  Direction enum provides four directions (UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT) and Pa19Helper provides getOpposite() returning the opposite direction
  and getOffset() returning the unit coordinate offset for movement calculations.

  Game: Operations to place a pipe, skip, undo, advance water flow, check win, check loss; convenience fromString
  constructor; maintain step count. 
Operation placePipe: This method maps the player column letter to an internal column index using col - 'A' + 1, 
keeps row unchanged, and places the pipe at cells[row][colIndex]. For example, placePipe(1, 'A') targets cells[1][1].
Operation skipPipe: Consumes the current pipe from the queue and increments the step count. Operation
  undoStep: Pops the last placed cell from CellStack, restores the pipe to the queue head, clears the cell on the map,
  and increments the step count. Returns false if there are no steps to undo.

  Map: Cells are stored as a 2D array Cell[][] with indices [0..rows-1] × [0..cols-1],
  where index 0 and rows-1/cols-1 are walls (border). The playable area occupies
  internal indices [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2], which aligns with 1-based
  user input mapping. tryPlacePipe(row, col, pipe) accepts playable-area aligned coordinates (row and col in [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2]) and uses them
  directly as array indices (no conversion needed due to the wall alignment).
  It rejects: (1) row/col outside [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2], (2) non-FillableCell,
  or (3) already-occupied cell.

  Cell family: Cell.fromChar parses map chars to concrete cells; FillableCell holds an optional pipe and renders pipe or
  '.'; TerminationCell holds pointingTo direction and Type (SOURCE/SINK), with filled state for rendering; Wall renders
  wall char.

  TerminationCell.toSingleChar: Returns the corresponding arrow character based on the current termination cell's
  filling state and pointingTo direction: when filled, returns the arrow from PipePatterns.Filled; when unfilled,
  returns the arrow from PipePatterns.Unfilled. Both SOURCE and SINK use pointingTo directly without direction reversal.
  Throws IllegalStateException("Invalid pointingTo value!") for unknown direction.

  Pipe: Expose connection directions via getConnections() returning Direction[] based on Shape; char rendering by
  filled/unfilled state; construct from short string code (HZ, VT, TL, TR, BL, BR, CR). getConnections(): Returns the
  list of connection directions based on the current pipe shape; throws IllegalStateException("Unknown shape") if the
  shape is not recognized. toSingleChar(): Returns the character representation of this pipe, different for filled and
  unfilled pipes.

  Water Flow: fillBeginTile() marks the source cell as filled. fillTiles(distance) fills pipes within the specified
  distance from source using BFS-style expansion. Water propagates along pipes only when adjacent pipes have matching
  connection directions (one pipe's direction must be the opposite of the other). Each round increments the fill
  distance by 1.

  Win/Loss Conditions: checkPath() uses BFS to determine if a connected path exists from SOURCE to SINK by following
  (i) from SOURCE, step once in the SOURCE pointingTo direction, and (ii) from a pipe cell, step in each pipe connection direction.
  It does not require the traversed pipes to be filled; reaching the SINK cell implies win. hasLost() returns true when prevFilledTiles == 0,
  meaning no new pipes were filled in the previous round (loss condition). The game checks loss only after delay has ended (distance > 0).

  PipeQueue: peek/consume/undo head pipe and auto-refill to fixed length with random shapes. undo(Pipe) inserts the pipe
  back to the front of the queue.

  DelayBar: countdown() decrements the current value by 1 each round. distance() returns -currentValue, representing how
  far the water should flow (negative during countdown, positive after delay ends).

  CellStack: push/pop last placement; undoCount counts the number of successful undo actions (i.e., successful pop
  operations), not the current stack size; 

  External/Tool Classes (not generated; handwritten or reused,You only need to assume that these Java files mentioned below are already in the pa19 package.)
  Pa19Helper is a small helper/assembly class used to build core game model objects for this project. It provides
  convenience methods to (1) construct a Game by wiring together Map, PipeQueue, DelayBar, and CellStack from given
  inputs, and (2) create/parse basic elements (e.g., Map from a Cell[][] or string representation, map characters/short
  codes into Cell/Pipe). It also centralizes simple direction utilities (opposite direction and unit offsets) used
  during parsing and movement-related calculations.
  Deserializer: Purpose: deserialize map input into runtime objects. Field: Path path (input file path). Constructors:
  Deserializer(String path) delegates to private Deserializer(Path); private Deserializer(Path) validates file existence
  and throws FileNotFoundException if missing. Methods: Game parseGame() reads rows, cols, delay, map lines, and
  optional default pipes, then returns Pa19Helper.createGame(...); on unexpected EOF or I/O failure, returns null
  (and logs error). static Cell[][] parseString(int rows, int cols, String cellsRep) converts multiline text to a Cell
  matrix by character, using Pa19Helper.cellFromChar with SINK type on border cells and SOURCE type on inner
  cells. private String getFirstNonEmptyLine(BufferedReader br) returns the first non-blank, non-comment line (ignores
  lines starting with #), or null at end of stream.

  PipePatterns: Purpose: central constant repository for all map-rendering characters. Design: final utility class with
  private constructor (non-instantiable). Exposed constants: WALL (solid wall block), plus two nested static groups:
  Filled and Unfilled. Each group defines arrow chars (UP_ARROW, DOWN_ARROW, LEFT_ARROW, RIGHT_ARROW) and pipe-shape
  chars (HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL, TOP_LEFT, TOP_RIGHT, BOTTOM_LEFT, BOTTOM_RIGHT, CROSS). Use PipePatterns constants for
  all rendering chars; do not hardcode glyphs in TerminationCell and PipeShape logic.

  StringUtils: Purpose: provide lightweight string helper utilities. Class design: utility class with a private
  constructor to prevent instantiation. 
```

# Requirement
```text
 Overall/Domain description.
 Console pipe-connection game: grid with outer walls, one source inside pointing inward, one sink on the border
  pointing outward. Player places pipes from a queue; after a delay, water flows along placed pipes.
Cell[][] uses 0-based array indices, but index 0 and rows-1/cols-1 are occupied by the outer wall border. Therefore, the playable area starts at internal index 1: [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2]. Player-facing coordinates are deliberately aligned with these playable indices: row 1 maps to internal row 1, column 'A' maps to internal col 1. No row-1/col-1 conversion is performed.
 Direction provides four directions plus opposite/offset; PipeShape defines
  connection
  directions; TerminationType distinguishes SOURCE vs SINK.

  Functional Requirements

Coordinate and Direction: Coordinate.row and Coordinate.col represent internal Cell[][] array indices and are used directly as cells[row][col]. A Cell stored at cells[r][c] should have Coordinate(row=r, col=c). 
Because the outer wall border occupies index 0, playable cells naturally start at index 1, so player input aligns with internal playable indices.
  Direction enum provides four directions (UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT) and Pa19Helper provides getOpposite() returning the opposite direction
  and getOffset() returning the unit coordinate offset for movement calculations.

  Game: Operations to place a pipe, skip, undo, advance water flow, check win, check loss; convenience fromString
  constructor; maintain step count. 
Operation placePipe: This method maps the player column letter to an internal column index using col - 'A' + 1, 
keeps row unchanged, and places the pipe at cells[row][colIndex]. For example, placePipe(1, 'A') targets cells[1][1].
Operation skipPipe: Consumes the current pipe from the queue and increments the step count. Operation
  undoStep: Pops the last placed cell from CellStack, restores the pipe to the queue head, clears the cell on the map,
  and increments the step count. Returns false if there are no steps to undo.

  Map: Cells are stored as a 2D array Cell[][] with indices [0..rows-1] × [0..cols-1],
  where index 0 and rows-1/cols-1 are walls (border). The playable area occupies
  internal indices [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2], which aligns with 1-based
  user input mapping. tryPlacePipe(row, col, pipe) accepts playable-area aligned coordinates (row and col in [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2]) and uses them
  directly as array indices (no conversion needed due to the wall alignment).
  It rejects: (1) row/col outside [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2], (2) non-FillableCell,
  or (3) already-occupied cell.

  Cell family: Cell.fromChar parses map chars to concrete cells; FillableCell holds an optional pipe and renders pipe or
  '.'; TerminationCell holds pointingTo direction and Type (SOURCE/SINK), with filled state for rendering; Wall renders
  wall char.

  TerminationCell.toSingleChar: Returns the corresponding arrow character based on the current termination cell's
  filling state and pointingTo direction: when filled, returns the arrow from PipePatterns.Filled; when unfilled,
  returns the arrow from PipePatterns.Unfilled. Both SOURCE and SINK use pointingTo directly without direction reversal.
  Throws IllegalStateException("Invalid pointingTo value!") for unknown direction.

  Pipe: Expose connection directions via getConnections() returning Direction[] based on Shape; char rendering by
  filled/unfilled state; construct from short string code (HZ, VT, TL, TR, BL, BR, CR). getConnections(): Returns the
  list of connection directions based on the current pipe shape; throws IllegalStateException("Unknown shape") if the
  shape is not recognized. toSingleChar(): Returns the character representation of this pipe, different for filled and
  unfilled pipes.

  Water Flow: fillBeginTile() marks the source cell as filled. fillTiles(distance) fills pipes within the specified
  distance from source using BFS-style expansion. Water propagates along pipes only when adjacent pipes have matching
  connection directions (one pipe's direction must be the opposite of the other). Each round increments the fill
  distance by 1.

  Win/Loss Conditions: checkPath() uses BFS to determine if a connected path exists from SOURCE to SINK by following
  (i) from SOURCE, step once in the SOURCE pointingTo direction, and (ii) from a pipe cell, step in each pipe connection direction.
  It does not require the traversed pipes to be filled; reaching the SINK cell implies win. hasLost() returns true when prevFilledTiles == 0,
  meaning no new pipes were filled in the previous round (loss condition). The game checks loss only after delay has ended (distance > 0).

  PipeQueue: peek/consume/undo head pipe and auto-refill to fixed length with random shapes. undo(Pipe) inserts the pipe
  back to the front of the queue.

  DelayBar: countdown() decrements the current value by 1 each round. distance() returns -currentValue, representing how
  far the water should flow (negative during countdown, positive after delay ends).

  CellStack: push/pop last placement; undoCount counts the number of successful undo actions (i.e., successful pop
  operations), not the current stack size; 

  External/Tool Classes (not generated; handwritten or reused,You only need to assume that these Java files mentioned below are already in the pa19 package.)
  Pa19Helper is a small helper/assembly class used to build core game model objects for this project. It provides
  convenience methods to (1) construct a Game by wiring together Map, PipeQueue, DelayBar, and CellStack from given
  inputs, and (2) create/parse basic elements (e.g., Map from a Cell[][] or string representation, map characters/short
  codes into Cell/Pipe). It also centralizes simple direction utilities (opposite direction and unit offsets) used
  during parsing and movement-related calculations.
  Deserializer: Purpose: deserialize map input into runtime objects. Field: Path path (input file path). Constructors:
  Deserializer(String path) delegates to private Deserializer(Path); private Deserializer(Path) validates file existence
  and throws FileNotFoundException if missing. Methods: Game parseGame() reads rows, cols, delay, map lines, and
  optional default pipes, then returns Pa19Helper.createGame(...); on unexpected EOF or I/O failure, returns null
  (and logs error). static Cell[][] parseString(int rows, int cols, String cellsRep) converts multiline text to a Cell
  matrix by character, using Pa19Helper.cellFromChar with SINK type on border cells and SOURCE type on inner
  cells. private String getFirstNonEmptyLine(BufferedReader br) returns the first non-blank, non-comment line (ignores
  lines starting with #), or null at end of stream.

  PipePatterns: Purpose: central constant repository for all map-rendering characters. Design: final utility class with
  private constructor (non-instantiable). Exposed constants: WALL (solid wall block), plus two nested static groups:
  Filled and Unfilled. Each group defines arrow chars (UP_ARROW, DOWN_ARROW, LEFT_ARROW, RIGHT_ARROW) and pipe-shape
  chars (HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL, TOP_LEFT, TOP_RIGHT, BOTTOM_LEFT, BOTTOM_RIGHT, CROSS). Use PipePatterns constants for
  all rendering chars; do not hardcode glyphs in TerminationCell and PipeShape logic.

  StringUtils: Purpose: provide lightweight string helper utilities. Class design: utility class with a private
  constructor to prevent instantiation.

# Requirement
```text
 Overall/Domain description.
 Console pipe-connection game: grid with outer walls, one source inside pointing inward, one sink on the border
  pointing outward. Player places pipes from a queue; after a delay, water flows along placed pipes.
Cell[][] uses 0-based array indices, but index 0 and rows-1/cols-1 are occupied by the outer wall border. Therefore, the playable area starts at internal index 1: [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2]. Player-facing coordinates are deliberately aligned with these playable indices: row 1 maps to internal row 1, column 'A' maps to internal col 1. No row-1/col-1 conversion is performed.
 Direction provides four directions plus opposite/offset; PipeShape defines
  connection
  directions; TerminationType distinguishes SOURCE vs SINK.

  Functional Requirements

Coordinate and Direction: Coordinate.row and Coordinate.col represent internal Cell[][] array indices and are used directly as cells[row][col]. A Cell stored at cells[r][c] should have Coordinate(row=r, col=c). 
Because the outer wall border occupies index 0, playable cells naturally start at index 1, so player input aligns with internal playable indices.
  Direction enum provides four directions (UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT) and Pa19Helper provides getOpposite() returning the opposite direction
  and getOffset() returning the unit coordinate offset for movement calculations.

  Game: Operations to place a pipe, skip, undo, advance water flow, check win, check loss; convenience fromString
  constructor; maintain step count. 
Operation placePipe: This method maps the player column letter to an internal column index using col - 'A' + 1, 
keeps row unchanged, and places the pipe at cells[row][colIndex]. For example, placePipe(1, 'A') targets cells[1][1].
Operation skipPipe: Consumes the current pipe from the queue and increments the step count. Operation
  undoStep: Pops the last placed cell from CellStack, restores the pipe to the queue head, clears the cell on the map,
  and increments the step count. Returns false if there are no steps to undo.

  Map: Cells are stored as a 2D array Cell[][] with indices [0..rows-1] × [0..cols-1],
  where index 0 and rows-1/cols-1 are walls (border). The playable area occupies
  internal indices [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2], which aligns with 1-based
  user input mapping. tryPlacePipe(row, col, pipe) accepts playable-area aligned coordinates (row and col in [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2]) and uses them
  directly as array indices (no conversion needed due to the wall alignment).
  It rejects: (1) row/col outside [1..rows-2] × [1..cols-2], (2) non-FillableCell,
  or (3) already-occupied cell.

  Cell family: Cell.fromChar parses map chars to concrete cells; FillableCell holds an optional pipe and renders pipe or
  '.'; TerminationCell holds pointingTo direction and Type (SOURCE/SINK), with filled state for rendering; Wall renders
  wall char.

  TerminationCell.toSingleChar: Returns the corresponding arrow character based on the current termination cell's
  filling state and pointingTo direction: when filled, returns the arrow from PipePatterns.Filled; when unfilled,
  returns the arrow from PipePatterns.Unfilled. Both SOURCE and SINK use pointingTo directly without direction reversal.
  Throws IllegalStateException("Invalid pointingTo value!") for unknown direction.

  Pipe: Expose connection directions via getConnections() returning Direction[] based on Shape; char rendering by
  filled/unfilled state; construct from short string code (HZ, VT, TL, TR, BL, BR, CR). getConnections(): Returns the
  list of connection directions based on the current pipe shape; throws IllegalStateException("Unknown shape") if the
  shape is not recognized. toSingleChar(): Returns the character representation of this pipe, different for filled and
  unfilled pipes.

  Water Flow: fillBeginTile() marks the source cell as filled. fillTiles(distance) fills pipes within the specified
  distance from source using BFS-style expansion. Water propagates along pipes only when adjacent pipes have matching
  connection directions (one pipe's direction must be the opposite of the other). Each round increments the fill
  distance by 1.

  Win/Loss Conditions: checkPath() uses BFS to determine if a connected path exists from SOURCE to SINK by following
  (i) from SOURCE, step once in the SOURCE pointingTo direction, and (ii) from a pipe cell, step in each pipe connection direction.
  It does not require the traversed pipes to be filled; reaching the SINK cell implies win. hasLost() returns true when prevFilledTiles == 0,
  meaning no new pipes were filled in the previous round (loss condition). The game checks loss only after delay has ended (distance > 0).

  PipeQueue: peek/consume/undo head pipe and auto-refill to fixed length with random shapes. undo(Pipe) inserts the pipe
  back to the front of the queue.

  DelayBar: countdown() decrements the current value by 1 each round. distance() returns -currentValue, representing how
  far the water should flow (negative during countdown, positive after delay ends).

  CellStack: push/pop last placement; undoCount counts the number of successful undo actions (i.e., successful pop
  operations), not the current stack size; 

  External/Tool Classes (not generated; handwritten or reused,You only need to assume that these Java files mentioned below are already in the pa19 package.)
  Pa19Helper is a small helper/assembly class used to build core game model objects for this project. It provides
  convenience methods to (1) construct a Game by wiring together Map, PipeQueue, DelayBar, and CellStack from given
  inputs, and (2) create/parse basic elements (e.g., Map from a Cell[][] or string representation, map characters/short
  codes into Cell/Pipe). It also centralizes simple direction utilities (opposite direction and unit offsets) used
  during parsing and movement-related calculations.
  Deserializer: Purpose: deserialize map input into runtime objects. Field: Path path (input file path). Constructors:
  Deserializer(String path) delegates to private Deserializer(Path); private Deserializer(Path) validates file existence
  and throws FileNotFoundException if missing. Methods: Game parseGame() reads rows, cols, delay, map lines, and
  optional default pipes, then returns Pa19Helper.createGame(...); on unexpected EOF or I/O failure, returns null
  (and logs error). static Cell[][] parseString(int rows, int cols, String cellsRep) converts multiline text to a Cell
  matrix by character, using Pa19Helper.cellFromChar with SINK type on border cells and SOURCE type on inner
  cells. private String getFirstNonEmptyLine(BufferedReader br) returns the first non-blank, non-comment line (ignores
  lines starting with #), or null at end of stream.

  PipePatterns: Purpose: central constant repository for all map-rendering characters. Design: final utility class with
  private constructor (non-instantiable). Exposed constants: WALL (solid wall block), plus two nested static groups:
  Filled and Unfilled. Each group defines arrow chars (UP_ARROW, DOWN_ARROW, LEFT_ARROW, RIGHT_ARROW) and pipe-shape
  chars (HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL, TOP_LEFT, TOP_RIGHT, BOTTOM_LEFT, BOTTOM_RIGHT, CROSS). Use PipePatterns constants for
  all rendering chars; do not hardcode glyphs in TerminationCell and PipeShape logic.

  StringUtils: Purpose: provide lightweight string helper utilities. Class design: utility class with a private
  constructor to prevent instantiation. 
```

- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

   *      c. Update the map's prevFilledTiles/prevFilledDistance tracking so that the next hasLost()

   * Algorithm:

- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

   * Summary: Propagates water outward from the source, filling connected pipes whose connections match, up to the given distance, using BFS-style expansion.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Initialize a BFS queue seeded with the source cell (assumed already filled via fillBeginTile()).
   *   2. Maintain a visited set / per-tile distance tracking relative to the source.
   *   3. While the queue is not empty and the current distance is within the input distance:
   *        a. Dequeue the front cell.
   *        b. For each of the four Direction values, compute the adjacent coordinate using Pa19Helper.getOffset(dir).
   *        c. If the adjacent cell is out of bounds or already visited, skip.
   *        d. If the current cell's pipe has a connection in direction dir AND the adjacent cell's pipe has a connection in Pa19Helper.getOpposite(dir), the connection matches; mark the adjacent cell as filled and enqueue it.
   *   4. After BFS, record prevFilledTiles as the number of tiles newly filled in this round and prevFilledDistance as the input distance.
   * Related Features: filledTiles (list of newly filled coordinates), sourceCell, prevFilledTiles, prevFilledDistance, cell (Cell[][] grid).
   * Related Classes: Direction, Pipe, Coordinate, FillableCell, Pa19Helper
   * Input:
   *   - distance (int): the maximum BFS distance from the source at which water should fill pipes; each round increments this value by 1.
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - The source cell exists and has been marked as filled by fillBeginTile().
   *   - distance is a non-negative integer representing how far water has progressed from the source.
   * Post-condition:

   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Initialize a BFS queue seeded with the source cell (assumed already filled via fillBeginTile()).
   *   2. Maintain a visited set / per-tile distance tracking relative to the source.
   *   3. While the queue is not empty and the current distance is within the input distance:
   *        a. Dequeue the front cell.
   *        b. For each of the four Direction values, compute the adjacent coordinate using Pa19Helper.getOffset(dir).
   *        c. If the adjacent cell is out of bounds or already visited, skip.
   *        d. If the current cell's pipe has a connection in direction dir AND the adjacent cell's pipe has a connection in Pa19Helper.getOpposite(dir), the connection matches; mark the adjacent cell as filled and enqueue it.
   *   4. After BFS, record prevFilledTiles as the number of tiles newly filled in this round and prevFilledDistance as the input distance.
   * Related Features: filledTiles (list of newly filled coordinates), sourceCell, prevFilledTiles, prevFilledDistance, cell (Cell[][] grid).

   *   2. Maintain a visited set / per-tile distance tracking relative to the source.

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        // Add to filledTiles
        Coordinate fillCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fillCoord.setRow(r);
        fillCoord.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fillCoord);
        
        newFilled++;
        
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
  if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
    return false;
  }
  Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
  if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
    return false;
  }
  FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
  if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
    return false;
  }
  fc.setPipe(pipe);
  return true;
}

public void undo(final Coordinate coord)
{
  Cell c = getCell()[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
  if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
    FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
    fc.setPipe(null);
  }
}

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      boolean currentHasConn = false;
      if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
        currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
      } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
        currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
      }
      
      boolean adjHasConn = false;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
        adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
      }
      
      if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fc.setRow(r);
        fc.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fc);
        
        newFilled++;
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
}
```

Now I realize: the "current cell's pipe" check for the source (TerminationCell) is special. The source cell has its `pointingTo` direction. From the source, we expand in that direction. So when current is the source (TerminationCell), we check if `pointingTo == dir`.

OK, I think this implementation is correct. Let me finalize.

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        // Add to filledTiles
        Coordinate fillCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fillCoord.setRow(r);
        fillCoord.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fillCoord);
        
        newFilled++;
        
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

From the Pa19Helper summary: `public Direction getOpposite(final Direction dir)` and `public Coordinate getOffset(final Direction dir)`. So these are regular Java methods. Good.

public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
  if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
    return false;
  }
  Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
  if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
    return false;
  }
  FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
  if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
    return false;
  }
  fc.setPipe(pipe);
  return true;
}

  }

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      boolean currentHasConn = false;
      if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
        currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
      } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
        currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
      }
      
      boolean adjHasConn = false;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
        adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
      }
      
      if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fc.setRow(r);
        fc.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fc);
        
        newFilled++;
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
}
```

Now I realize: the "current cell's pipe" check for the source (TerminationCell) is special. The source cell has its `pointingTo` direction. From the source, we expand in that direction. So when current is the source (TerminationCell), we check if `pointingTo == dir`.

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        // Add to filledTiles
        Coordinate fillCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fillCoord.setRow(r);
        fillCoord.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fillCoord);
        
        newFilled++;
        
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        // Add to filledTiles
        Coordinate fillCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fillCoord.setRow(r);
        fillCoord.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fillCoord);
        
        newFilled++;
        
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
  if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
    return false;
  }
  Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
  if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
    return false;
  }
  FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
  if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
    return false;
  }
  fc.setPipe(pipe);
  return true;
}

public void undo(final Coordinate coord)
{
  Cell c = getCell()[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
  if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
    FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
    fc.setPipe(null);
  }
}

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      boolean currentHasConn = false;
      if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
        currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
      } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
        currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
      }
      
      boolean adjHasConn = false;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
        adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
      }
      
      if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fc.setRow(r);
        fc.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fc);
        
        newFilled++;
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
}
```

Now I realize: the "current cell's pipe" check for the source (TerminationCell) is special. The source cell has its `pointingTo` direction. From the source, we expand in that direction. So when current is the source (TerminationCell), we check if `pointingTo == dir`.

OK, I think this implementation is correct. Let me finalize.

  public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
  {
    if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
      return false;
    }
    Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
    if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
      return false;
    }
    FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
    if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
      return false;
    }
    fc.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
  }

  public void undo(final Coordinate coord)
  {
    Cell c = getCell()[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
    if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
      ((FillableCell) c).setPipe(null);
    }
  }

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<Cell>();
    HashMap<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<Cell, Integer>();
    
    queue.add(getSourceCell());
    dist.put(getSourceCell(), Integer.valueOf(0));
    
    int newFilled = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty())
    {
      Cell current = queue.poll();
      int d = dist.get(current).intValue();
      if (d >= distance) continue;
      
      for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
      {
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
        int r = adjCoord.getRow();
        int c = adjCoord.getCol();
        
        if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
        
        Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
        if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
        
        boolean currentHasConn = false;
        if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
          currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
        } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
          currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
        }
        
        boolean adjHasConn = false;
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
          adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
        }
        
        if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
        {
          if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
            ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
          } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
            ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
          }
          
          Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
          fc.setRow(r);
          fc.setCol(c);
          getFilledTiles().add(fc);
          
          newFilled++;
          queue.add(adj);
          dist.put(adj, Integer.valueOf(d + 1));
        }
      }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
    setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
  }

  public boolean hasLost()
  {
    return getPrevFilledTiles() == 0;
  }
}

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      boolean currentHasConn = false;
      if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
        currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
      } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
        currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
      }
      
      boolean adjHasConn = false;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
        adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
      }
      
      if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fc.setRow(r);
        fc.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fc);
        
        newFilled++;
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
}
```

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        // Add to filledTiles
        Coordinate fillCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fillCoord.setRow(r);
        fillCoord.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fillCoord);
        
        newFilled++;
        
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
  if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
    return false;
  }
  Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
  if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
    return false;
  }
  FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
  if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
    return false;
  }
  fc.setPipe(pipe);
  return true;
}

public void undo(final Coordinate coord)
{
  Cell c = getCell()[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
  if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
    FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
    fc.setPipe(null);
  }
}

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      boolean currentHasConn = false;
      if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
        currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
      } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
        currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
      }
      
      boolean adjHasConn = false;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
        adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
      }
      
      if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fc.setRow(r);
        fc.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fc);
        
        newFilled++;
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
}
```

Now I realize: the "current cell's pipe" check for the source (TerminationCell) is special. The source cell has its `pointingTo` direction. From the source, we expand in that direction. So when current is the source (TerminationCell), we check if `pointingTo == dir`.

OK, I think this implementation is correct. Let me finalize.

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        // Add to filledTiles
        Coordinate fillCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fillCoord.setRow(r);
        fillCoord.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fillCoord);
        
        newFilled++;
        
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
  if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
    return false;
  }
  Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
  if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
    return false;
  }
  FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
  if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
    return false;
  }
  fc.setPipe(pipe);
  return true;
}

public void undo(final Coordinate coord)
{
  Cell c = getCell()[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
  if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
    FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
    fc.setPipe(null);
  }
}

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      boolean currentHasConn = false;
      if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
        currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
      } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
        currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
      }
      
      boolean adjHasConn = false;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
        adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
      }
      
      if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fc.setRow(r);
        fc.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fc);
        
        newFilled++;
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
}
```

Now I realize: the "current cell's pipe" check for the source (TerminationCell) is special. The source cell has its `pointingTo` direction. From the source, we expand in that direction. So when current is the source (TerminationCell), we check if `pointingTo == dir`.

OK, I think this implementation is correct. Let me finalize.

  public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
  {
    if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
      return false;
    }
    Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
    if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
      return false;
    }
    FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
    if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
      return false;
    }
    fc.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
  }

  public void undo(final Coordinate coord)
  {
    Cell c = getCell()[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
    if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
      ((FillableCell) c).setPipe(null);
    }
  }

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<Cell>();
    HashMap<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<Cell, Integer>();
    
    queue.add(getSourceCell());
    dist.put(getSourceCell(), Integer.valueOf(0));
    
    int newFilled = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty())
    {
      Cell current = queue.poll();
      int d = dist.get(current).intValue();
      if (d >= distance) continue;
      
      for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
      {
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
        int r = adjCoord.getRow();
        int c = adjCoord.getCol();
        
        if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
        
        Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
        if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
        
        boolean currentHasConn = false;
        if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
          currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
        } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
          currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
        }
        
        boolean adjHasConn = false;
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
          adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
        }
        
        if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
        {
          if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
            ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
          } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
            ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
          }
          
          Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
          fc.setRow(r);
          fc.setCol(c);
          getFilledTiles().add(fc);
          
          newFilled++;
          queue.add(adj);
          dist.put(adj, Integer.valueOf(d + 1));
        }
      }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
    setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
  }

  public boolean hasLost()
  {
    return getPrevFilledTiles() == 0;
  }
}

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        // Add to filledTiles
        Coordinate fillCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fillCoord.setRow(r);
        fillCoord.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fillCoord);
        
        newFilled++;
        
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
  if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
    return false;
  }
  Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
  if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
    return false;
  }
  FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
  if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
    return false;
  }
  fc.setPipe(pipe);
  return true;
}

public void undo(final Coordinate coord)
{
  Cell c = getCell()[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
  if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
    FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
    fc.setPipe(null);
  }
}

    return p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
  } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
    return ((TerminationCell) cell).getPointingTo() == dir;
  }
  return false;
}

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      boolean currentHasConn = false;
      if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
        currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
      } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
        currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
      }
      
      boolean adjHasConn = false;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
        adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
      }
      
      if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fc.setRow(r);
        fc.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fc);
        
        newFilled++;
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
}
```

Now I realize: the "current cell's pipe" check for the source (TerminationCell) is special. The source cell has its `pointingTo` direction. From the source, we expand in that direction. So when current is the source (TerminationCell), we check if `pointingTo == dir`.

OK, I think this implementation is correct. Let me finalize.

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        // Add to filledTiles
        Coordinate fillCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fillCoord.setRow(r);
        fillCoord.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fillCoord);
        
        newFilled++;
        
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

From the Pa19Helper summary: `public Direction getOpposite(final Direction dir)` and `public Coordinate getOffset(final Direction dir)`. So these are regular Java methods. Good.

{

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      boolean currentHasConn = false;
      if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
        currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
      } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
        currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
      }
      
      boolean adjHasConn = false;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
        adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
      }
      
      if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fc.setRow(r);
        fc.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fc);
        
        newFilled++;
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
}
```

Now I realize: the "current cell's pipe" check for the source (TerminationCell) is special. The source cell has its `pointingTo` direction. From the source, we expand in that direction. So when current is the source (TerminationCell), we check if `pointingTo == dir`.

OK, I think this implementation is correct. Let me finalize.

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        // Add to filledTiles
        Coordinate fillCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fillCoord.setRow(r);
        fillCoord.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fillCoord);
        
        newFilled++;
        
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      boolean currentHasConn = false;
      if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
        currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
      } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
        currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
      }
      
      boolean adjHasConn = false;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
        adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
      }
      
      if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fc.setRow(r);
        fc.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fc);
        
        newFilled++;
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
}
```

Now I realize: the "current cell's pipe" check for the source (TerminationCell) is special. The source cell has its `pointingTo` direction. From the source, we expand in that direction. So when current is the source (TerminationCell), we check if `pointingTo == dir`.

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      boolean currentHasConn = false;
      if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
        currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
      } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
        currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
      }
      
      boolean adjHasConn = false;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
        adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
      }
      
      if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fc.setRow(r);
        fc.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fc);
        
        newFilled++;
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
}
```

Now I realize: the "current cell's pipe" check for the source (TerminationCell) is special. The source cell has its `pointingTo` direction. From the source, we expand in that direction. So when current is the source (TerminationCell), we check if `pointingTo == dir`.

   *   4. After BFS, record prevFilledTiles as the number of tiles newly filled in this round and prevFilledDistance as the input distance.
   * Related Features: filledTiles (list of newly filled coordinates), sourceCell, prevFilledTiles, prevFilledDistance, cell (Cell[][] grid).
