```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        // Add to filledTiles
        Coordinate fillCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fillCoord.setRow(r);
        fillCoord.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fillCoord);
        
        newFilled++;
        
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
  if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
    return false;
  }
  Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
  if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {

  if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
    return false;

    fc.setPipe(null);

{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();

      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;

   *   2. Maintain a visited set / per-tile distance tracking relative to the source.

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        // Add to filledTiles
        Coordinate fillCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fillCoord.setRow(r);
        fillCoord.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fillCoord);
        
        newFilled++;
        
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}

public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
  if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
    return false;
  }
  Cell c = getCell()[row][col];

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      boolean currentHasConn = false;
      if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
        currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
      } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
        currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
      }
      
      boolean adjHasConn = false;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
        adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
      }
      
      if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fc.setRow(r);
        fc.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fc);
        
        newFilled++;
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
}

          Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
          currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
        } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
          currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
        }
        
        boolean adjHasConn = false;
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
          adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
        }
        
        if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
        {
          if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
            ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
          } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
            ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
          }
          
          Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
          fc.setRow(r);
          fc.setCol(c);
          getFilledTiles().add(fc);
          
          newFilled++;
          queue.add(adj);
          dist.put(adj, Integer.valueOf(d + 1));
        }
      }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
    setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
  }

  public boolean hasLost()
  {
    return getPrevFilledTiles() == 0;
  }
}

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<Cell>();
    HashMap<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<Cell, Integer>();
    
    queue.add(getSourceCell());
    dist.put(getSourceCell(), Integer.valueOf(0));
    
    int newFilled = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty())
    {
      Cell current = queue.poll();
      int d = dist.get(current).intValue();
      if (d >= distance) continue;
      
      for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
      {
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
        int r = adjCoord.getRow();
        int c = adjCoord.getCol();
        
        if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
        
        Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
        if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
        
        boolean currentHasConn = false;
        if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
          currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
        } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
          currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
        }
        
        boolean adjHasConn = false;
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
          adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
        }
        
        if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
        {
          if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
            ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
          } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
            ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
          }
          
          Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
          fc.setRow(r);
          fc.setCol(c);
          getFilledTiles().add(fc);
          
          newFilled++;
          queue.add(adj);
          dist.put(adj, Integer.valueOf(d + 1));
        }
      }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
    setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
  }

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        // Add to filledTiles
        Coordinate fillCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fillCoord.setRow(r);
        fillCoord.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fillCoord);
        
        newFilled++;
        
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
  if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
    return false;
  }
  Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
  if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
    return false;
  }
  FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
  if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
    return false;
  }
  fc.setPipe(pipe);
  return true;
}

public void undo(final Coordinate coord)
{
  Cell c = getCell()[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
  if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
    FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
    fc.setPipe(null);
  }
}

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      boolean currentHasConn = false;
      if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
        currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
      } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
        currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
      }
      
      boolean adjHasConn = false;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
        adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
      }
      
      if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fc.setRow(r);
        fc.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fc);
        
        newFilled++;
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
}
```

Now I realize: the "current cell's pipe" check for the source (TerminationCell) is special. The source cell has its `pointingTo` direction. From the source, we expand in that direction. So when current is the source (TerminationCell), we check if `pointingTo == dir`.

OK, I think this implementation is correct. Let me finalize.

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<Cell>();
    HashMap<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<Cell, Integer>();
    
    queue.add(getSourceCell());
    dist.put(getSourceCell(), Integer.valueOf(0));
    
    int newFilled = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty())
    {
      Cell current = queue.poll();
      int d = dist.get(current).intValue();
      if (d >= distance) continue;
      
      for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
      {
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
        int r = adjCoord.getRow();
        int c = adjCoord.getCol();
        
        if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
        
        Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
        if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
        
        boolean currentHasConn = false;
        if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
          currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
        } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
          currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
        }
        
        boolean adjHasConn = false;
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
          adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
        }
        
        if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
        {

            ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);

          fc.setRow(r);
          fc.setCol(c);
          getFilledTiles().add(fc);
          
          newFilled++;
          queue.add(adj);
          dist.put(adj, Integer.valueOf(d + 1));
        }
      }
    }

    setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
  }

   * Summary: Propagates water outward from the source, filling connected pipes whose connections match, up to the given distance, using BFS-style expansion.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Initialize a BFS queue seeded with the source cell (assumed already filled via fillBeginTile()).
   *   2. Maintain a visited set / per-tile distance tracking relative to the source.
   *   3. While the queue is not empty and the current distance is within the input distance:
   *        a. Dequeue the front cell.
   *        b. For each of the four Direction values, compute the adjacent coordinate using Pa19Helper.getOffset(dir).
   *        c. If the adjacent cell is out of bounds or already visited, skip.
   *        d. If the current cell's pipe has a connection in direction dir AND the adjacent cell's pipe has a connection in Pa19Helper.getOpposite(dir), the connection matches; mark the adjacent cell as filled and enqueue it.
   *   4. After BFS, record prevFilledTiles as the number of tiles newly filled in this round and prevFilledDistance as the input distance.
   * Related Features: filledTiles (list of newly filled coordinates), sourceCell, prevFilledTiles, prevFilledDistance, cell (Cell[][] grid).
   * Related Classes: Direction, Pipe, Coordinate, FillableCell, Pa19Helper
   * Input:
   *   - distance (int): the maximum BFS distance from the source at which water should fill pipes; each round increments this value by 1.
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - The source cell exists and has been marked as filled by fillBeginTile().
   *   - distance is a non-negative integer representing how far water has progressed from the source.
   * Post-condition:

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        // Add to filledTiles
        Coordinate fillCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fillCoord.setRow(r);
        fillCoord.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fillCoord);
        
        newFilled++;
        
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
  if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
    return false;
  }
  Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
  if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
    return false;
  }
  FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
  if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
    return false;
  }
  fc.setPipe(pipe);
  return true;
}

public void undo(final Coordinate coord)
{
  Cell c = getCell()[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
  if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
    FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
    fc.setPipe(null);
  }
}

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      boolean currentHasConn = false;
      if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
        currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
      } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
        currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
      }
      
      boolean adjHasConn = false;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
        adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
      }
      
      if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fc.setRow(r);
        fc.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fc);
        
        newFilled++;
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
}
```

Now I realize: the "current cell's pipe" check for the source (TerminationCell) is special. The source cell has its `pointingTo` direction. From the source, we expand in that direction. So when current is the source (TerminationCell), we check if `pointingTo == dir`.

  public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
  {
    if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
      return false;
    }
    Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
    if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
      return false;
    }
    FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
    if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
      return false;
    }
    fc.setPipe(pipe);
    return true;
  }

  public void undo(final Coordinate coord)
  {
    Cell c = getCell()[coord.getRow()][coord.getCol()];
    if (c instanceof FillableCell) {
      ((FillableCell) c).setPipe(null);
    }
  }

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<Cell>();
    HashMap<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<Cell, Integer>();
    
    queue.add(getSourceCell());
    dist.put(getSourceCell(), Integer.valueOf(0));
    
    int newFilled = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty())
    {
      Cell current = queue.poll();
      int d = dist.get(current).intValue();
      if (d >= distance) continue;
      
      for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
      {
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
        int r = adjCoord.getRow();
        int c = adjCoord.getCol();
        
        if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
        
        Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
        if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
        
        boolean currentHasConn = false;
        if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
          currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
        } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
          currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
        }
        
        boolean adjHasConn = false;
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
          adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
        }
        
        if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
        {
          if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
            ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
          } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
            ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
          }
          
          Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
          fc.setRow(r);
          fc.setCol(c);
          getFilledTiles().add(fc);
          
          newFilled++;
          queue.add(adj);
          dist.put(adj, Integer.valueOf(d + 1));
        }
      }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
    setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
  }

  public boolean hasLost()
  {
    return getPrevFilledTiles() == 0;
  }
}

   *   4. After BFS, record prevFilledTiles as the number of tiles newly filled in this round and prevFilledDistance as the input distance.
   * Related Features: filledTiles (list of newly filled coordinates), sourceCell, prevFilledTiles, prevFilledDistance, cell (Cell[][] grid).

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        // Add to filledTiles
        Coordinate fillCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fillCoord.setRow(r);
        fillCoord.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fillCoord);
        
        newFilled++;
        
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
  if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
    return false;
  }
  Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
  if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {

  if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
    return false;

    fc.setPipe(null);

{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();

      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;

  {

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();

    HashMap<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<Cell, Integer>();
    
    queue.add(getSourceCell());
    dist.put(getSourceCell(), Integer.valueOf(0));
    
    int newFilled = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty())
    {
      Cell current = queue.poll();
      int d = dist.get(current).intValue();
      if (d >= distance) continue;
      
      for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
      {
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
        int r = adjCoord.getRow();
        int c = adjCoord.getCol();
        
        if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
        
        Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
        if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        // Add to filledTiles
        Coordinate fillCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fillCoord.setRow(r);
        fillCoord.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fillCoord);
        
        newFilled++;
        
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
  if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
    return false;
  }
  Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
  if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
    return false;
  }
  FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
  if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
    return false;
  }
  fc.setPipe(pipe);
  return true;

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      boolean currentHasConn = false;
      if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
        currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
      } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
        currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
      }
      
      boolean adjHasConn = false;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
        adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
      }
      
      if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fc.setRow(r);
        fc.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fc);
        
        newFilled++;
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
}
```

Now I realize: the "current cell's pipe" check for the source (TerminationCell) is special. The source cell has its `pointingTo` direction. From the source, we expand in that direction. So when current is the source (TerminationCell), we check if `pointingTo == dir`.

Now let me also examine the BFS algorithm one more time. Looking at the docstring:
- "Initialize a BFS queue seeded with the source cell (assumed already filled via fillBeginTile())"
- "Maintain a visited set / per-tile distance tracking relative to the source"
- "While the queue is not empty and the current distance is within the input distance"
- "After BFS, record prevFilledTiles as the number of tiles newly filled in this round and prevFilledDistance as the input distance"

The condition "current distance is within the input distance" means current distance < distance (since we want to fill tiles AT distance, not beyond).

For the BFS, I'll use a queue and a map for distance tracking.

For the source cell, the pipe check doesn't apply (since the source is a TerminationCell). The "connection" for a TerminationCell is its `pointingTo` direction.

Now, the key question is: what does "tiles newly filled" mean? It's the count of cells that were marked as filled in this round. The source is already filled, so it doesn't count.

  {

      return false;
    }

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<Cell>();
    HashMap<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<Cell, Integer>();
    
    queue.add(getSourceCell());
    dist.put(getSourceCell(), Integer.valueOf(0));
    
    int newFilled = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty())
    {
      Cell current = queue.poll();
      int d = dist.get(current).intValue();
      if (d >= distance) continue;
      
      for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
      {
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
        int r = adjCoord.getRow();
        int c = adjCoord.getCol();
        
        if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
        
        Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
        if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
        
        boolean currentHasConn = false;
        if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
          currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
        } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
          currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
        }
        
        boolean adjHasConn = false;
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
          adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
        }

          fc.setCol(c);

          queue.add(adj);

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  
  // Seed with source cell
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    // Get the current cell's pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = null;
    if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
      currentPipe = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
    }
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      // Out of bounds
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      Pipe adjPipe = null;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        adjPipe = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
      }
      
      if (currentPipe != null && currentPipe.getConnections().contains(dir) &&
          adjPipe != null && adjPipe.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir)))
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          adjPipe.setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        // Add to filledTiles
        Coordinate fillCoord = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fillCoord.setRow(r);
        fillCoord.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fillCoord);
        
        newFilled++;
        
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
```

```java
public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
  if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
    return false;
  }
  Cell c = getCell()[row][col];
  if (!(c instanceof FillableCell)) {
    return false;
  }
  FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) c;
  if (fc.getPipe() != null) {
    return false;
  }
  fc.setPipe(pipe);
  return true;

```java
public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
  Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
  Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
  java.util.Map<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<>();
  
  queue.add(getSourceCell());
  dist.put(getSourceCell(), 0);
  
  int newFilled = 0;
  
  while (!queue.isEmpty())
  {
    Cell current = queue.poll();
    int d = dist.get(current);
    if (d >= distance) continue;
    
    for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
    {
      Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
      Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
      int r = adjCoord.getRow();
      int c = adjCoord.getCol();
      
      if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
      
      Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
      if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
      
      // Check connections
      boolean currentHasConn = false;
      if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
        currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
      } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
        currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
      }
      
      boolean adjHasConn = false;
      if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
        Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
        adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
      }
      
      if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
      {
        // Mark as filled
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
        } else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell) {
          ((TerminationCell)adj).setFilled(true);
        }
        
        Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
        fc.setRow(r);
        fc.setCol(c);
        getFilledTiles().add(fc);
        
        newFilled++;
        queue.add(adj);
        dist.put(adj, d + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  
  setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
  setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
}
```

Now I realize: the "current cell's pipe" check for the source (TerminationCell) is special. The source cell has its `pointingTo` direction. From the source, we expand in that direction. So when current is the source (TerminationCell), we check if `pointingTo == dir`.

Now let me also examine the BFS algorithm one more time. Looking at the docstring:
- "Initialize a BFS queue seeded with the source cell (assumed already filled via fillBeginTile())"
- "Maintain a visited set / per-tile distance tracking relative to the source"
- "While the queue is not empty and the current distance is within the input distance"
- "After BFS, record prevFilledTiles as the number of tiles newly filled in this round and prevFilledDistance as the input distance"

The condition "current distance is within the input distance" means current distance < distance (since we want to fill tiles AT distance, not beyond).

For the BFS, I'll use a queue and a map for distance tracking.

For the source cell, the pipe check doesn't apply (since the source is a TerminationCell). The "connection" for a TerminationCell is its `pointingTo` direction.

Now, the key question is: what does "tiles newly filled" mean? It's the count of cells that were marked as filled in this round. The source is already filled, so it doesn't count.

  {

      return false;
    }

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<Cell>();
    HashMap<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<Cell, Integer>();
    
    queue.add(getSourceCell());
    dist.put(getSourceCell(), Integer.valueOf(0));
    
    int newFilled = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty())
    {
      Cell current = queue.poll();
      int d = dist.get(current).intValue();
      if (d >= distance) continue;
      
      for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
      {
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
        int r = adjCoord.getRow();
        int c = adjCoord.getCol();
        
        if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols()) continue;
        
        Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
        if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj)) continue;
        
        boolean currentHasConn = false;
        if (current instanceof FillableCell) {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell)current).getPipe();
          currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
        } else if (current instanceof TerminationCell) {
          currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell)current).getPointingTo() == dir;
        }
        
        boolean adjHasConn = false;
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell) {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell)adj).getPipe();
          adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
        }

          fc.setCol(c);

          queue.add(adj);

   * Summary: Propagates water outward from the source, filling connected pipes whose connections match, up to the given distance, using BFS-style expansion.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Initialize a BFS queue seeded with the source cell (assumed already filled via fillBeginTile()).
   *   2. Maintain a visited set / per-tile distance tracking relative to the source.

   *        c. If the adjacent cell is out of bounds or already visited, skip.

   * Related Classes: Direction, Pipe, Coordinate, FillableCell, Pa19Helper

   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<Cell>();
    HashMap<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<Cell, Integer>();

    queue.add(getSourceCell());
    dist.put(getSourceCell(), Integer.valueOf(0));

    int newFilled = 0;

    while (!queue.isEmpty())
    {
      Cell current = queue.poll();
      int d = dist.get(current).intValue();
      if (d >= distance)
      {
        continue;
      }

      for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
      {
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
        int r = adjCoord.getRow();
        int c = adjCoord.getCol();

        if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols())
        {
          continue;
        }

        Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
        if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj))
        {
          continue;
        }

        boolean currentHasConn = false;
        if (current instanceof FillableCell)
        {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell) current).getPipe();
          currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
        }
        else if (current instanceof TerminationCell)
        {
          currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell) current).getPointingTo() == dir;
        }

        boolean adjHasConn = false;
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell)
        {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell) adj).getPipe();
          adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
        }

        if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
        {
          if (adj instanceof FillableCell)
          {
            ((FillableCell) adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
          }
          else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell)
          {
            ((TerminationCell) adj).setFilled(true);
          }

          Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
          fc.setRow(r);
          fc.setCol(c);
          getFilledTiles().add(fc);

          newFilled++;
          queue.add(adj);
          dist.put(adj, Integer.valueOf(d + 1));
        }
      }
    }

    setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
    setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));

   * Summary: Advances the game by one round by ticking down the delay bar and, once the delay has ended,
   *          propagating the water flow from the SOURCE.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Call delayBar.countdown() to decrement the delay counter by 1.
   *   2. distance = delayBar.distance() (i.e. -delayBar.currentValue).
   *   3. If distance > 0 (water is now flowing):
   *      a. If distance == 1 (the delay has just ended):
   *         - Call map.fillBeginTile() to mark the SOURCE cell as filled.
   *      b. Call map.fillTiles(distance) to expand the water, in BFS style, along pipes whose
   *         connections match the adjacent cell's direction, up to the requested distance.
   *      c. Update the map's prevFilledTiles/prevFilledDistance tracking so that the next hasLost()
   *         check reflects how many tiles were filled this round.
   * Related Features: delayBar, map
   * Related Classes: DelayBar, Map
   * Input: None
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: The map and delay bar must be initialized.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - delayBar.currentValue is decreased by 1.
   *   - If the delay has just ended (distance == 1), the SOURCE is marked as filled.
   *   - If water is now flowing (distance > 0), water has propagated outward from the SOURCE through
   *     connected pipes up to distance delayBar.distance() from the SOURCE.
   *   - The map's prevFilledTiles/prevFilledDistance reflect this round's fill progress.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */

  {
    getDelayBar().countdown();
    final int distance = getDelayBar().distance();
    if (distance > 0)
    {
      if (distance == 1)
      {
        getMap().fillBeginTile();
      }
      getMap().fillTiles(distance);
      getMap().setPrevFilledTiles(getMap().getFilledTiles().size());
      getMap().setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
    }

   * Summary: Places the next pipe from the pipe queue onto the map at the given player-facing row and column.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Compute the internal column index: colIndex = col - 'A' + 1.
   *   2. Peek the head pipe from pipeQueue (do not consume yet).
   *   3. Call map.tryPlacePipe(row, colIndex, pipe) to attempt the placement.
   *   4. If the placement succeeds:
   *      a. Push the newly created FillableCell onto cellStack.
   *      b. Call pipeQueue.consume() to remove the head pipe.
   *      c. Increment numOfSteps.
   *      d. Return true.
   *   5. If the placement fails (out of range / not FillableCell / already occupied), return false and leave
   *      the queue and step count unchanged.
   * Related Features: numOfSteps, cellStack, map, pipeQueue
   * Related Classes: Map, PipeQueue, CellStack, FillableCell, Pipe
   * Input:
   *   row - int, the player-facing row index in [1..rows-2] (no row offset is applied).
   *   col - char, the player-facing column letter (e.g. 'A'); the internal index is col - 'A' + 1,
   *         which must lie in [1..cols-2].
   * Output: boolean - true if the pipe was placed, false otherwise.
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - pipeQueue must contain at least one pipe.
   *   - The cell at cells[row][colIndex] must be a FillableCell inside the playable area and must not be
   *     currently occupied.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - On success: cells[row][colIndex] holds the new pipe, the cell is recorded on top of cellStack,
   *     the pipe is removed from pipeQueue, and numOfSteps is incremented by 1.
   *   - On failure: the map, cellStack, pipeQueue, and numOfSteps are unchanged.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public boolean placePipe(final int row, final char col)
  {
    final int colIndex = col - 'A' + 1;
    final Pipe pipe = getPipeQueue().peek();
    final FillableCell placed = getMap().tryPlacePipe(row, colIndex, pipe);
    if (placed != null)
    {
      getCellStack().push(placed);
      getPipeQueue().consume();
      setNumOfSteps(getNumOfSteps() + 1);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

   * Summary: Advances the game by one round by ticking down the delay bar and, once the delay has ended,
   *          propagating the water flow from the SOURCE.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Call delayBar.countdown() to decrement the delay counter by 1.
   *   2. distance = delayBar.distance() (i.e. -delayBar.currentValue).
   *   3. If distance > 0 (water is now flowing):
   *      a. If distance == 1 (the delay has just ended):
   *         - Call map.fillBeginTile() to mark the SOURCE cell as filled.
   *      b. Call map.fillTiles(distance) to expand the water, in BFS style, along pipes whose
   *         connections match the adjacent cell's direction, up to the requested distance.
   *      c. Update the map's prevFilledTiles/prevFilledDistance tracking so that the next hasLost()

   * Related Classes: DelayBar, Map
   * Input: None
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: The map and delay bar must be initialized.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - delayBar.currentValue is decreased by 1.
   *   - If the delay has just ended (distance == 1), the SOURCE is marked as filled.
   *   - If water is now flowing (distance > 0), water has propagated outward from the SOURCE through
   *     connected pipes up to distance delayBar.distance() from the SOURCE.
   *   - The map's prevFilledTiles/prevFilledDistance reflect this round's fill progress.

   * @generated NOT

  public void updateState()
  {
    getDelayBar().countdown();
    final int distance = getDelayBar().distance();
    if (distance > 0)
    {
      if (distance == 1)
      {
        getMap().fillBeginTile();
      }
      getMap().fillTiles(distance);
      getMap().setPrevFilledTiles(getMap().getFilledTiles().size());
      getMap().setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
    }

   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Propagates water outward from the source, filling connected pipes whose connections match, up to the given distance, using BFS-style expansion.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Initialize a BFS queue seeded with the source cell (assumed already filled via fillBeginTile()).
   *   2. Maintain a visited set / per-tile distance tracking relative to the source.
   *   3. While the queue is not empty and the current distance is within the input distance:
   *        a. Dequeue the front cell.
   *        b. For each of the four Direction values, compute the adjacent coordinate using Pa19Helper.getOffset(dir).
   *        c. If the adjacent cell is out of bounds or already visited, skip.
   *        d. If the current cell's pipe has a connection in direction dir AND the adjacent cell's pipe has a connection in Pa19Helper.getOpposite(dir), the connection matches; mark the adjacent cell as filled and enqueue it.
   *   4. After BFS, record prevFilledTiles as the number of tiles newly filled in this round and prevFilledDistance as the input distance.
   * Related Features: filledTiles (list of newly filled coordinates), sourceCell, prevFilledTiles, prevFilledDistance, cell (Cell[][] grid).
   * Related Classes: Direction, Pipe, Coordinate, FillableCell, Pa19Helper
   * Input:
   *   - distance (int): the maximum BFS distance from the source at which water should fill pipes; each round increments this value by 1.
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - The source cell exists and has been marked as filled by fillBeginTile().
   *   - distance is a non-negative integer representing how far water has progressed from the source.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - All reachable pipe cells whose distance from the source is less than or equal to the input distance and whose connection directions match an adjacent filled pipe are marked as filled.
   *   - prevFilledTiles is updated to the number of newly filled tiles in this round.
   *   - prevFilledDistance is updated to the input distance value.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<Cell>();
    HashMap<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<Cell, Integer>();

    queue.add(getSourceCell());
    dist.put(getSourceCell(), Integer.valueOf(0));

    int newFilled = 0;

    while (!queue.isEmpty())
    {
      Cell current = queue.poll();
      int d = dist.get(current).intValue();
      if (d >= distance)
      {
        continue;
      }

      for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
      {
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
        int r = adjCoord.getRow();
        int c = adjCoord.getCol();

        if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols())
        {
          continue;
        }

        Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
        if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj))
        {
          continue;
        }

        boolean currentHasConn = false;
        if (current instanceof FillableCell)
        {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell) current).getPipe();
          currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
        }
        else if (current instanceof TerminationCell)
        {
          currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell) current).getPointingTo() == dir;
        }

        boolean adjHasConn = false;
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell)
        {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell) adj).getPipe();
          adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
        }

        if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
        {
          if (adj instanceof FillableCell)
          {
            ((FillableCell) adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
          }
          else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell)
          {
            ((TerminationCell) adj).setFilled(true);
          }

          Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
          fc.setRow(r);
          fc.setCol(c);
          getFilledTiles().add(fc);

          newFilled++;
          queue.add(adj);
          dist.put(adj, Integer.valueOf(d + 1));
        }
      }
    }

    setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
    setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
  }

   * Output: void

   *   - prevFilledTiles is updated to the number of newly filled tiles in this round.

  {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<Cell>();
    HashMap<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<Cell, Integer>();

    queue.add(getSourceCell());
    dist.put(getSourceCell(), Integer.valueOf(0));

    int newFilled = 0;

    while (!queue.isEmpty())
    {
      Cell current = queue.poll();
      int d = dist.get(current).intValue();
      if (d >= distance)
      {
        continue;
      }

      for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
      {
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
        int r = adjCoord.getRow();
        int c = adjCoord.getCol();

        if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols())
        {
          continue;
        }

        Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
        if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj))
        {
          continue;
        }

        boolean currentHasConn = false;
        if (current instanceof FillableCell)
        {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell) current).getPipe();
          currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
        }
        else if (current instanceof TerminationCell)
        {
          currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell) current).getPointingTo() == dir;
        }

        boolean adjHasConn = false;
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell)
        {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell) adj).getPipe();
          adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
        }

        if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
        {
          if (adj instanceof FillableCell)
          {
            ((FillableCell) adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
          }
          else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell)
          {

          }

          fc.setCol(c);
          getFilledTiles().add(fc);

          newFilled++;
          queue.add(adj);
          dist.put(adj, Integer.valueOf(d + 1));
        }
      }
    }

    setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));

   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Propagates water outward from the source, filling connected pipes whose connections match, up to the given distance, using BFS-style expansion.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Initialize a BFS queue seeded with the source cell (assumed already filled via fillBeginTile()).
   *   2. Maintain a visited set / per-tile distance tracking relative to the source.
   *   3. While the queue is not empty and the current distance is within the input distance:
   *        a. Dequeue the front cell.
   *        b. For each of the four Direction values, compute the adjacent coordinate using Pa19Helper.getOffset(dir).
   *        c. If the adjacent cell is out of bounds or already visited, skip.
   *        d. If the current cell's pipe has a connection in direction dir AND the adjacent cell's pipe has a connection in Pa19Helper.getOpposite(dir), the connection matches; mark the adjacent cell as filled and enqueue it.
   *   4. After BFS, record prevFilledTiles as the number of tiles newly filled in this round and prevFilledDistance as the input distance.
   * Related Features: filledTiles (list of newly filled coordinates), sourceCell, prevFilledTiles, prevFilledDistance, cell (Cell[][] grid).
   * Related Classes: Direction, Pipe, Coordinate, FillableCell, Pa19Helper
   * Input:

   * Output: void

   * Post-condition:

   *   - prevFilledTiles is updated to the number of newly filled tiles in this round.

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<Cell>();
    HashMap<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<Cell, Integer>();

    queue.add(getSourceCell());
    dist.put(getSourceCell(), Integer.valueOf(0));

    int newFilled = 0;

    while (!queue.isEmpty())
    {
      Cell current = queue.poll();
      int d = dist.get(current).intValue();
      if (d >= distance)
      {
        continue;
      }

      for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
      {
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
        int r = adjCoord.getRow();
        int c = adjCoord.getCol();

        if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols())
        {
          continue;
        }

        Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
        if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj))
        {
          continue;
        }

        boolean currentHasConn = false;
        if (current instanceof FillableCell)
        {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell) current).getPipe();
          currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
        }
        else if (current instanceof TerminationCell)
        {

        }

        {

          {

          }
          else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell)

   * Summary: Propagates water outward from the source, filling connected pipes whose connections match, up to the given distance, using BFS-style expansion.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Initialize a BFS queue seeded with the source cell (assumed already filled via fillBeginTile()).
   *   2. Maintain a visited set / per-tile distance tracking relative to the source.
   *   3. While the queue is not empty and the current distance is within the input distance:
   *        a. Dequeue the front cell.
   *        b. For each of the four Direction values, compute the adjacent coordinate using Pa19Helper.getOffset(dir).
   *        c. If the adjacent cell is out of bounds or already visited, skip.
   *        d. If the current cell's pipe has a connection in direction dir AND the adjacent cell's pipe has a connection in Pa19Helper.getOpposite(dir), the connection matches; mark the adjacent cell as filled and enqueue it.
   *   4. After BFS, record prevFilledTiles as the number of tiles newly filled in this round and prevFilledDistance as the input distance.
   * Related Features: filledTiles (list of newly filled coordinates), sourceCell, prevFilledTiles, prevFilledDistance, cell (Cell[][] grid).
   * Related Classes: Direction, Pipe, Coordinate, FillableCell, Pa19Helper
   * Input:
   *   - distance (int): the maximum BFS distance from the source at which water should fill pipes; each round increments this value by 1.
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - The source cell exists and has been marked as filled by fillBeginTile().
   *   - distance is a non-negative integer representing how far water has progressed from the source.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - All reachable pipe cells whose distance from the source is less than or equal to the input distance and whose connection directions match an adjacent filled pipe are marked as filled.
   *   - prevFilledTiles is updated to the number of newly filled tiles in this round.
   *   - prevFilledDistance is updated to the input distance value.

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<Cell>();
    HashMap<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<Cell, Integer>();

    queue.add(getSourceCell());
    dist.put(getSourceCell(), Integer.valueOf(0));

    int newFilled = 0;

    while (!queue.isEmpty())
    {
      Cell current = queue.poll();
      int d = dist.get(current).intValue();
      if (d >= distance)
      {
        continue;
      }

      for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
      {
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
        int r = adjCoord.getRow();
        int c = adjCoord.getCol();

        if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols())
        {
          continue;
        }

        Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
        if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj))
        {
          continue;
        }

        boolean currentHasConn = false;
        if (current instanceof FillableCell)
        {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell) current).getPipe();
          currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
        }
        else if (current instanceof TerminationCell)
        {
          currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell) current).getPointingTo() == dir;
        }

        boolean adjHasConn = false;
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell)
        {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell) adj).getPipe();
          adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
        }

        if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
        {
          if (adj instanceof FillableCell)
          {
            ((FillableCell) adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
          }
          else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell)
          {
            ((TerminationCell) adj).setFilled(true);
          }

          Coordinate fc = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createCoordinate();
          fc.setRow(r);
          fc.setCol(c);
          getFilledTiles().add(fc);

          newFilled++;
          queue.add(adj);
          dist.put(adj, Integer.valueOf(d + 1));
        }
      }
    }

    setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
    setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));
  }

   * Summary: Propagates water outward from the source, filling connected pipes whose connections match, up to the given distance, using BFS-style expansion.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Initialize a BFS queue seeded with the source cell (assumed already filled via fillBeginTile()).
   *   2. Maintain a visited set / per-tile distance tracking relative to the source.
   *   3. While the queue is not empty and the current distance is within the input distance:
   *        a. Dequeue the front cell.
   *        b. For each of the four Direction values, compute the adjacent coordinate using Pa19Helper.getOffset(dir).
   *        c. If the adjacent cell is out of bounds or already visited, skip.
   *        d. If the current cell's pipe has a connection in direction dir AND the adjacent cell's pipe has a connection in Pa19Helper.getOpposite(dir), the connection matches; mark the adjacent cell as filled and enqueue it.
   *   4. After BFS, record prevFilledTiles as the number of tiles newly filled in this round and prevFilledDistance as the input distance.
   * Related Features: filledTiles (list of newly filled coordinates), sourceCell, prevFilledTiles, prevFilledDistance, cell (Cell[][] grid).
   * Related Classes: Direction, Pipe, Coordinate, FillableCell, Pa19Helper
   * Input:
   *   - distance (int): the maximum BFS distance from the source at which water should fill pipes; each round increments this value by 1.
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - The source cell exists and has been marked as filled by fillBeginTile().
   *   - distance is a non-negative integer representing how far water has progressed from the source.
   * Post-condition:

   *   - prevFilledTiles is updated to the number of newly filled tiles in this round.

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<Cell>();
    HashMap<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<Cell, Integer>();

    queue.add(getSourceCell());
    dist.put(getSourceCell(), Integer.valueOf(0));

    int newFilled = 0;

    while (!queue.isEmpty())
    {
      Cell current = queue.poll();
      int d = dist.get(current).intValue();
      if (d >= distance)
      {
        continue;
      }

      for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
      {
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
        int r = adjCoord.getRow();
        int c = adjCoord.getCol();

        if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols())
        {
          continue;
        }

        Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
        if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj))
        {
          continue;
        }

        boolean currentHasConn = false;
        if (current instanceof FillableCell)
        {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell) current).getPipe();
          currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
        }
        else if (current instanceof TerminationCell)
        {
          currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell) current).getPointingTo() == dir;
        }

        boolean adjHasConn = false;
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell)
        {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell) adj).getPipe();
          adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
        }

        if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)
        {
          if (adj instanceof FillableCell)
          {
            ((FillableCell) adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
          }
          else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell)
          {
            ((TerminationCell) adj).setFilled(true);

          fc.setRow(r);
          fc.setCol(c);
          getFilledTiles().add(fc);

          newFilled++;
          queue.add(adj);
          dist.put(adj, Integer.valueOf(d + 1));
        }
      }
    }

    setPrevFilledTiles(newFilled);
    setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));

   * Summary: Propagates water outward from the source, filling connected pipes whose connections match, up to the given distance, using BFS-style expansion.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Initialize a BFS queue seeded with the source cell (assumed already filled via fillBeginTile()).
   *   2. Maintain a visited set / per-tile distance tracking relative to the source.
   *   3. While the queue is not empty and the current distance is within the input distance:

   *        b. For each of the four Direction values, compute the adjacent coordinate using Pa19Helper.getOffset(dir).
   *        c. If the adjacent cell is out of bounds or already visited, skip.

   *   4. After BFS, record prevFilledTiles as the number of tiles newly filled in this round and prevFilledDistance as the input distance.
   * Related Features: filledTiles (list of newly filled coordinates), sourceCell, prevFilledTiles, prevFilledDistance, cell (Cell[][] grid).
   * Related Classes: Direction, Pipe, Coordinate, FillableCell, Pa19Helper
   * Input:
   *   - distance (int): the maximum BFS distance from the source at which water should fill pipes; each round increments this value by 1.
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - The source cell exists and has been marked as filled by fillBeginTile().
   *   - distance is a non-negative integer representing how far water has progressed from the source.
   * Post-condition:

   *   - prevFilledTiles is updated to the number of newly filled tiles in this round.

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<Cell>();
    HashMap<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<Cell, Integer>();

    queue.add(getSourceCell());
    dist.put(getSourceCell(), Integer.valueOf(0));

    int newFilled = 0;

    while (!queue.isEmpty())
    {
      Cell current = queue.poll();
      int d = dist.get(current).intValue();
      if (d >= distance)
      {
        continue;
      }

      for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)
      {
        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);
        int r = adjCoord.getRow();
        int c = adjCoord.getCol();

        if (r < 0 || r >= getRows() || c < 0 || c >= getCols())
        {
          continue;
        }

        Cell adj = getCell()[r][c];
        if (adj == null || dist.containsKey(adj))
        {
          continue;
        }

        boolean currentHasConn = false;
        if (current instanceof FillableCell)
        {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell) current).getPipe();
          currentHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(dir);
        }
        else if (current instanceof TerminationCell)
        {
          currentHasConn = ((TerminationCell) current).getPointingTo() == dir;
        }

        boolean adjHasConn = false;
        if (adj instanceof FillableCell)
        {
          Pipe p = ((FillableCell) adj).getPipe();
          adjHasConn = p != null && p.getConnections().contains(helper.getOpposite(dir));
        }

        if (currentHasConn && adjHasConn)

          if (adj instanceof FillableCell)
          {
            ((FillableCell) adj).getPipe().setFilled(true);
          }
          else if (adj instanceof TerminationCell)

          newFilled++;
          queue.add(adj);
          dist.put(adj, Integer.valueOf(d + 1));
        }
      }
    }

    setPrevFilledDistance(Integer.valueOf(distance));

   * Algorithm:

    Deque<Cell> queue = new ArrayDeque<Cell>();
    HashMap<Cell, Integer> dist = new HashMap<Cell, Integer>();

    queue.add(getSourceCell());
    dist.put(getSourceCell(), Integer.valueOf(0));

    int newFilled = 0;

    while (!queue.isEmpty())
    {
      Cell current = queue.poll();
      int d = dist.get(current).intValue();
      if (d >= distance)
      {
        continue;
      }

      for (Direction dir : Direction.VALUES)

        Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
        Coordinate adjCoord = current.getCoord().add(offset);

   * Summary: Propagates water outward from the source, filling connected pipes whose connections match, up to the given distance, using BFS-style expansion.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Initialize a BFS queue seeded with the source cell (assumed already filled via fillBeginTile()).
   *   2. Maintain a visited set / per-tile distance tracking relative to the source.
   *   3. While the queue is not empty and the current distance is within the input distance:

   *        d. If the current cell's pipe has a connection in direction dir AND the adjacent cell's pipe has a connection in Pa19Helper.getOpposite(dir), the connection matches; mark the adjacent cell as filled and enqueue it.
   *   4. After BFS, record prevFilledTiles as the number of tiles newly filled in this round and prevFilledDistance as the input distance.
   * Related Features: filledTiles (list of newly filled coordinates), sourceCell, prevFilledTiles, prevFilledDistance, cell (Cell[][] grid).
   * Related Classes: Direction, Pipe, Coordinate, FillableCell, Pa19Helper
   * Input:
   *   - distance (int): the maximum BFS distance from the source at which water should fill pipes; each round increments this value by 1.
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - The source cell exists and has been marked as filled by fillBeginTile().
   *   - distance is a non-negative integer representing how far water has progressed from the source.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - All reachable pipe cells whose distance from the source is less than or equal to the input distance and whose connection directions match an adjacent filled pipe are marked as filled.
   *   - prevFilledTiles is updated to the number of newly filled tiles in this round.
